description: Foundations + the pure orchestration core (Slice A). Establishes the cross-seam error-classification pattern, the minimal slog-based observ.Tracer/Logger that satisfy Deps, and the real internal/flow package: Ctx accumulator (SetPath/GetPath), node specs, and the recursive tree-walking Interpreter with the five functional node handlers (trigger/action/condition/set/response) plus TODO-stub handlers for the deferred types. Imports NO infrastructure — all other slices are reached only through the Deps interface, so this feature is fully unit-testable with fakes. Realizes docs/lld/slice-a-interpreter.md §2,§3,§4 against the frozen contracts in docs/lld-contracts.md. Independent of FEAT-002/003 at the code level (depends on nothing); later features depend on it.
steps: Read docs/.agents/tasks/context.json and this file FIRST. Then read docs/lld-contracts.md (frozen Ctx/Node/NodeHandler/Directive/Walker/Deps + observ.Tracer/Span/Logger) and docs/lld/slice-a-interpreter.md (§2 specs, §3 interpreter/Walker, §4 SetPath/GetPath).

Create internal/observ/observ.go: implement Tracer (StartSpan returns ctx + Span), Span (End(err), Set(attr,v)), and Logger (Emit(ctx,level,label,fields)) over log/slog. Keep it basic and no-op-safe; a slog.Default()-backed impl is fine. Add doc comments on exported names.

Create internal/flow/errors.go: a classified error type (e.g. FlowError{Class, msg, cause}) with ErrClass constants Timeout/NotFound/Validation/Upstream/Internal, Error()/Unwrap(), and sentinel wrappers (ErrValidation, ErrTimeout, ...) usable with errors.Is/As. Wrap causes with %w. Lowercase error strings, no trailing punctuation.

Create internal/flow/ctx.go: Ctx is the contract type (RequestID, TraceID, Env, Input, Data, Response). Implement NewCtx(reqID, traceID, env string, input map[string]any) *Ctx; GetPath(path) (any, bool) reading the merged view in precedence Response -> Data -> Input, descending dotted segments through map[string]any and numeric segments through []any; SetPath(targetPath, v) error with lodash.set semantics: dotted + numeric paths, create-intermediate containers, assign ONLY the leaf (no sibling clobber), and return a Validation-class error on a type conflict (intermediate is a scalar). Never object-merge-overwrite siblings.
Create internal/flow/node.go: thin re-export/aliases for the contract Node/NodeType/Directive usage and the specTypes/handler registry wiring surface.

Create internal/flow/spec.go: parseSpec[T any](raw json.RawMessage) (T, error) using json.Decoder with DisallowUnknownFields (unknown field => Validation). Define the thin-slice spec structs: TriggerSpec (method/path/input), ActionSpec (ConnRef connection, connect.Operation, SaveAs, optional Resilience override, OnError), ConditionSpec (jdmId, input paths, trueKey, falseKey), SetSpec (targetPath, value|from, omitEmpty), ResponseSpec (status, bodyFrom). Also define spec stubs for the deferred types so the registry can name them.

Create internal/flow/interpreter.go: Interpreter struct holding handlers map[NodeType]NodeHandler; New() registers all handlers; Run(ctx, config.FlowVersion, *Ctx, Deps) error pins the version by value, starts a root span, walks &fv.Tree, and classifies the returned error at the seam; walk(ctx, *Node, *Ctx, Deps) (Directive, error) is the SINGLE recursion point, wraps each node in a span, dispatches to the handler, and passes the Interpreter itself as the Walker (sole implementer of Walker.Walk, no handler->interpreter import cycle). Carry a minimal budget (ctx-cancellation check + max-depth) on the walk; full budget is out of thin-slice scope but keep the depth guard.

Create internal/flow/handlers.go: triggerHandler (map TriggerSpec.Input into Ctx.Input then w.Walk the single child); actionHandler (parse ActionSpec, get client via dep.Conns.Client(key), build connect.Operation with the per-node timeout override, Execute, store result under SaveAs in Ctx.Data; OnError 'continue' records+continues, default fails); conditionHandler (project named input paths via GetPath into map[string]any, call dep.Decide.Evaluate(ctx, jdmId, input), choose trueKey/falseKey from the decision output, w.Walk only the chosen child, set Directive.Branch for trace); setHandler (resolve value from literal or From path, SetPath into Response); responseHandler (return Directive{Stop:true}). Register switch/parallel/forEach/decision/logger as TODO-stub handlers returning a Validation-class 'not implemented in thin slice' error.

Create internal/flow/ctx_test.go and internal/flow/interpreter_test.go: table-driven. ctx tests: SetPath sibling coexistence (order.id then order.total then flags.expedited all present), no-clobber of existing maps, numeric index paths, type-conflict => Validation; GetPath precedence + dotted/numeric descent. interpreter tests: a Trigger->Action->Condition->{Set->Response | Set->Response} tree walked with a FAKE Deps (fake Registry whose Client returns a fake Client.Execute, fake Evaluator returning a chosen branch) asserts the correct branch is taken, Directive.Branch is set, the stitched Response is correct, and a deferred-type node returns a Validation-class error.
acceptance_criteria: `CGO_ENABLED=1 go test ./internal/flow` passes all unit tests.
SetPath test proves sibling keys are never clobbered and a type conflict returns a Validation-class error (errors.Is against the Validation sentinel).
Interpreter test proves two inputs take different condition branches with a fake Evaluator and the stitched Response differs per branch.
Deferred node types (switch/parallel/forEach/decision/logger) return a Validation-class error, not a panic.
findings:
DONE. Verification (all pass): `CGO_ENABLED=1 go build ./internal/observ ./internal/flow` exit 0; `CGO_ENABLED=1 go test ./internal/flow` all pass (SetPath sibling-coexistence+no-clobber+numeric-index+type-conflict=>Validation; GetPath precedence Response>Data>Input + dotted/numeric descent; interpreter branch test proves expedited vs standard per fake Evaluator incl. branch-field and truthy-result selection; deferred/unknown node => Validation not panic; action-fail aborts, OnError:continue swallows; timeout override forwarded); `CGO_ENABLED=1 go vet ./internal/observ ./internal/flow` clean.

=== SEAM DEVIATION FEAT-003 MUST ADAPT TO (import-cycle break) ===
flow.Interpreter.Run does NOT take config.FlowVersion (that would make flow import config while config.FlowVersion.Tree is a flow.Node => cycle). Instead:
  func (ip *Interpreter) Run(ctx context.Context, tree *flow.Node, ver flow.Version, c *flow.Ctx, dep flow.Deps) error
  type flow.Version struct { FlowID string; Version int }
httpapi (FEAT-003) must call: interp.Run(ctx, &fv.Tree, flow.Version{FlowID: fv.FlowID, Version: fv.Version}, c, deps). This keeps internal/flow free of any infrastructure import. config.FlowVersion.Tree stays typed as flow.Node, so internal/config imports internal/flow (one-directional, no cycle).

=== CONTRACT SEAM FILES ALREADY CREATED BY FEAT-001 (FEAT-002 must NOT redeclare these symbols) ===
internal/connect/connect.go declares: Registry, Client, Operation (with Kind, Payload, Override *ResiliencePolicy, IdempotencyKey, Required), ResiliencePolicy (Timeout + Retry{MaxAttempts,BaseBackoff,MaxBackoff} + Breaker{FailureThreshold,FailureRatio,OpenTimeout}), ConnectionDef (Key,Type,Settings,SecretRef,Resilience). FEAT-002 adds in SEPARATE files: Connector, SecretProvider, Secret, ConnError/ErrClass, the registry/resilientClient impls, mergePolicy func, drivers — but must NOT re-declare Registry/Client/Operation/ResiliencePolicy/ConnectionDef.
internal/decision/decision.go declares: Evaluator interface only. FEAT-002 adds JDMLoader, Engine, cache, zen_cgo/zen_stub in separate files; must NOT re-declare Evaluator.

-- internal/observ (observ.go) --

func NewTracer(log *slog.Logger) Tracer   // nil log => slog.Default

=== HANDLER CONTROL-FLOW MODEL (thin slice; matches the proven internal/spikeflow and the FEAT-002 seed Trigger->Action->Condition->Set->Response chain) ===
Trigger/Action/Set are LINEAR parents: after their own work they walk n.Children IN ORDER via Walker, stopping early on Directive.Stop (shared helper walkChildren). Condition selects exactly ONE child by key (TrueKey/FalseKey; branch-field wins, else truthy 'result') and sets Directive.Branch. Response returns Directive{Stop:true} to short-circuit upward. Deferred types (switch/parallel/forEach/decision/logger) + unknown types return a Validation error (never panic). actionHandler applies the per-node timeout override (ResilienceOverride.TimeoutMS -> op.Override.Timeout) and saves result under SaveAs in Ctx.Data; OnError:continue records+continues. NOTE: dry-run write-suppression (observ.IsDryRun) from lld-contracts is NOT yet wired in actionHandler (thin slice has no dry-run path); FEAT-003/later must add it when observ gains WithDryRun/IsDryRun.
